stays_within: internal bounded research only; shadow only; no control/PPO/Gate promotion; old packages untouched
objective: add a two-class identity channel (central tower vs verified similar structure MS1) and test whether it restores the consumer chain (identity + reference availability + horizontal bearing + fresh observation) within the new budget

0.name: central_tower
0.semantics: central tower class evidence inside the bounded asset domain; mapping to landmark_id RMUC2027_CENTRAL_TOWER_PROPOSED requires recorded applicability assumptions and rejection rules
0.keypoint: green roof-light reference point; v=1 visible, v=0 unavailable; never inferred

1.name: similar_structure_ms1
1.semantics: verified map-native similar structure MS1 (world (3.0,4.0), z_top approx 1.78 m); this class must NEVER be mapped to the central tower landmark_id
1.keypoint: no same-semantic reference point -> v=0 always; pose/keypoint loss masked; bbox centre must NOT be used as a keypoint

classes.note: class1 is NOT an open-set catch-all for unknown objects; a two-class model does not claim open-set identity recognition

data_spec.same_frame_rule: every visible and decidable instance of both classes must be labelled; MS1 must never be left as background in a frame where it is visible/decidable
keypoint_rules: class0: one green roof-light keypoint; v=1 only when the reference is visible and locatable
class1: keypoint explicitly unavailable (v=0) and excluded from the keypoint loss; no guessing, no bbox-centre substitution
if a class0 reference is not visible -> keypoint v=0 and reference_available=false (refusal is correct)
data_spec.denominators: all-domain counts retained; observable-domain reported separately; no deletion of hard frames; TINY kept in all-domain
data_spec.tiny_policy: TINY results reported separately; not used to remove frames

training_data.train_rule: v4.1 one-class tower train (16 groups/1772 frames) + new two-class training families captured 2026-11-05; all new two-class families are independent trajectories not used by val/T19 identity/holdout
training_data.val_rule: val_main 163 (tower metrics; MS1 additionally labelled where visible) + T19 identity 7 groups/190 frames (62 labelled; both classes) for identity/class1 metrics; no train/val group overlap
training_data.label_audit: actual training inputs = image<->label 1:1 counts, not pool frame counts; report per-class instance counts, per-group counts, same-frame counts
training_data.immutable: freeze v6 split + labels + spec + protocol; snapshot manifest v7 (new, not reusing exhausted v1/v5 budgets); pre_train/pre_selection/post_train hash checks; any drift -> INVALID

recipes.default: R1: direct two-class fine-tune from frozen single-class v2 weights (stage_verify_v5/seed2 last, sha 6b86ef1f) on two-class train set; same imgsz/batch/warmup/patience
recipes.second_recipe_condition: enable R2 only on explicit pilot failure evidence (e.g. class1 recall collapse or class0 catastrophic regression) with a written cause; do not switch to larger models/segmentation without evidence

stage_gates.note: stage-specific; a later gate must never be used to reject an earlier stage (2026-11-04 errata)

conditions: two-class label loader valid (nc=2, kpt_shape[1,3])
class1 keypoint v=0 excluded from keypoint loss, class0 keypoint supervised (verified by loss-mask test)
tiny overfit on <=20 images reduces total loss
inference identity uses predicted boxes/classes/RGB only (no GT box/position/file name/oracle region)
existing single-class interfaces remain explicitly compatible (no silent label swap)
targeted tests pass
engineering_smoke.on_fail: fix implementation/data defect; not evidence about the method

pilot_to_three_seed.applies_to: single seed <=15 epoch pilot of a recipe, evaluated on validation only, thresholds frozen before evaluation
conditions: tower class recall (observable val_main 95) >= 0.70
MS1 class recall (identity 62 MS1 objects 35) >= 0.50
wrong central-tower claims on MS1-only frames (9) <= 1 frame
same-frame target disambiguation correct (both-visible frames denominator) >= 0.60
two-class identity precision (class0 claims correct) >= 0.95
consumer confirmed success all-positive >= 0.30 (trend; not the final gate)
bearing median <= 3.0 deg on reference-available emitted frames
tower recall not worse than frozen single-class baseline (0.821) by more than 0.08
pilot_to_three_seed.on_pass: promote the winning recipe to seeds 0/1/2, <=60 epochs each
pilot_to_three_seed.on_fail: reject recipe; stop that recipe; do not add epochs/seeds/candidates

three_seed_report.rule: report every seed, worst seed, worst condition group; selection only on validation; no consumer callback; no separate advance condition

consumer_development_to_holdout.applies_to: val-selected two-class model/thresholds/decoder/eval rules frozen after the 3-seed phase
conditions: consumer confirmed success (all-positive 121) >= 0.50 (two-class identity available, not raw unvalidated claim)
identity precision (class0 claims) >= 0.95 and MS1 false central-tower claims <= 0.05 on the MS1/negative denominator
same-frame target disambiguation correct >= 0.70
bearing median <= 3.0 deg and P90 <= 5.0 deg on reference-available emitted frames
reference declaration correct rate (GT-unavailable refusal) >= 0.50 and false-reference rate <= 0.10
worst-group consumer success not worse than frozen single-class baseline worst group by more than 0.05
consumer success exceeds frozen single-class raw-claim upper bound (0.479 val_main) by no requirement; but must be a confirmed-identity number (supplementary comparison reported)
consumer_development_to_holdout.on_fail: STOP this two-class version: no new holdout capture/evaluation; keep failure evidence; do not claim the architecture is falsified
consumer_development_to_holdout.on_pass: freeze and capture a new holdout

holdout.rules: sampling/annotation frozen before capture; no selection by model quality; one evaluation after model/thresholds/labels/evaluator frozen; no callback; process-isolated holdout (same-agent), not third-party sealed/certification

identity_output_rules.tower_claim: class0 detection with score>=tau_det and no class conflict -> may claim RMUC2027_CENTRAL_TOWER_PROPOSED with recorded assumption; otherwise UNKNOWN/REJECTED
identity_output_rules.ms1_claim: class1 must never map to central tower ID; if class1 and class0 both detected, evaluate whether the classes are correctly assigned (correct disambiguation is NOT an automatic rejection; reject only when the model cannot distinguish)
identity_output_rules.rejection: low confidence, class conflict on the same object, multi-target ambiguity, unavailable reference -> explicit UNKNOWN/REJECTED with reason

reports: reference availability + bearing error + success coverage
improper identity claims under GT-uncertain/fully-occluded frames
evaluation.denominator_policy: UNKNOWN/REJECTED/no-output stay in their applicable success denominators; GT_UNOBSERVABLE kept in all-domain and reported separately; no deletion of hard frames
evaluation.baseline: frozen single-class model v2 (sha 6b86ef1f) on the same consumer metrics; strict_unknown success=0 is a baseline fact, not the only improvement target

r1_pilot_result.recipe: R1 direct two-class fine-tune from frozen single-class v5 weights on v6.1 train (class1 183 instances)

evidence.note: metrics recomputed from the final prediction snapshot (shas recorded by evaltool); an earlier stale snapshot (overwritten at 12:19:54) is discarded

cause_analysis.primary: near-range MS1 (1.4-2.0 m) is out of the training size domain: class1 training bbox heights max 114.1 px (~2.6 m) vs identity MS1 18/35 >114.1 px and 17/35 >146 px (~<2.0 m); MS1 recall tracks this OOD proportion
secondary: class1 final classification conv re-initialised (6 tensors) while 391 backbone/neck/box/DFL/kpt tensors transfer; 15 epoch pilot remains in low-LR ramp-up
training val had class1=0 instances -> checkpoint selection/fitness blind to class1
checkpoint instability: last vs best differ strongly on tower recall/same-frame/MS1 recall -> a single frozen selection rule is required
rejected_causes: class0 keypoint [0,0] is a label v=0 placeholder, not a model regression: saved observations contain 0 [0,0] keypoints; decoder/export must add a hard guard to drop v=0/class1 references
cause_analysis.evidence: diag T41-style read-only review (TWO_CLASS pilot cause review, 2026-11-05)

r2_amendment.single_change: add two new near-range MS1 training families (1.3-2.2 m, MS1 bbox height target 140-220 px) to the v6.1 train set; keep R1 recipe, base weights, epochs=15, batch/imgsz, warmup/patience unchanged
unchanged: pilot gate conditions (MS1 recall >=0.50, wrong MS1-only tower claims <=1/9, same-frame >=0.60, tower recall >=0.70, identity precision >=0.95, consumer confirmed success >=0.30, bearing median <=3 deg, tower recall not worse than single-class 0.821 by >0.08)
no larger model, no segmentation, no threshold stacking
holdout only if the development gate passes

checkpoint_selection_rule_frozen.rule: computed on validation only, after R2 training, before any holdout/ONNX/consumer-gate decision; the selected checkpoint is frozen for all downstream evaluation; no consumer or holdout data participates in selection
checkpoint_selection_rule_frozen.consumer_metrics_role: reporting and development-gate decision only, never checkpoint selection

r2_amendment.expected_outcome: improves near-range class1 recall; if MS1 recall stays <0.50 the recipe is rejected and the two-class version stops (no 3-seed, no holdout)
r2_amendment.evidence_basis: diag cause review: near-range MS1 OOD (training max height 114.1 px vs identity 18/35 >114.1 px), class1 conv re-init and val class1=0 selection blindness
